title: Advanced Cleft Sentences
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Las 'Cleft Sentences' son tu arma secreta para dominar las presentaciones. Empezar una frase con 'What we need to focus on is...' capta la atención del público y dirige el mensaje exactamente hacia donde tú quieres.

parts.visual:
Las 'Cleft Sentences' (oraciones hendidas) se usan para destacar una parte específica de una oración. Dividimos (cleave) una oración simple en dos partes para darle foco a la información nueva o más importante. 

1. IT-Clefts (It is/was... that/who...): 
Normal: The CEO signed the contract yesterday. 
Énfasis en quién: IT WAS the CEO WHO signed the contract yesterday. (No el CFO). 
Énfasis en qué: IT WAS the contract THAT the CEO signed yesterday. (No la carta). 
Énfasis en cuándo: IT WAS yesterday THAT the CEO signed the contract.
parts.audio: Cleft sentences are used to highlight a specific part of a sentence. We divide, or cleave, a simple sentence into two clauses to focus on the new or most important information. Number 1: IT-Clefts. Structure: It is or was, plus the emphasized part, plus that or who. Normal sentence: The CEO signed the contract yesterday. To emphasize WHO did it: IT WAS the CEO WHO signed the contract yesterday. Not the C F O. To emphasize WHAT: IT WAS the contract THAT the CEO signed. To emphasize WHEN: IT WAS yesterday THAT the CEO signed the contract.

parts.visual:
2. WH-Clefts (What... is/was...): 
Sirven para destacar la acción entera o la cosa. 
Normal: We need more time. 
Cleft: WHAT we need IS more time. 
Normal: They want to cut the budget. 
Cleft: WHAT they want IS to cut the budget. 

3. ALL-Clefts (All... is/was... = lo único que): 
Normal: I only want a chance to explain. 
Cleft: ALL I want IS a chance to explain. 

4. THE REASON WHY / THE PLACE WHERE: 
Cleft: THE REASON WHY we failed WAS the lack of funding.
parts.audio: Number 2: WH-Clefts, starting with 'What'. These highlight the action or the thing. Normal: We need more time. Cleft sentence: WHAT we need IS more time. Normal: They want to cut the budget. Cleft: WHAT they want IS to cut the budget. Number 3: ALL-Clefts, meaning 'the only thing'. Normal: I only want a chance to explain. Cleft: ALL I want IS a chance to explain. Number 4: Using phrases like 'The reason why' or 'The place where'. Example: THE REASON WHY we failed WAS the lack of funding.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de Cleft Sentence.

questions.question: Normal: John made the mistake. -> Emphasis on John: ____ John who made the mistake.
questions.explanation: It-Cleft para personas: It was John who...

questions.question: Normal: We need better marketing. -> ____ we need is better marketing.
questions.explanation: Wh-Cleft para cosas/acciones: What we need is...

questions.question: Normal: I only asked for a small discount. -> ____ I asked for was a small discount.
questions.explanation: All-Cleft (lo único que): All I asked for was...

questions.question: Normal: We met in Paris. -> Emphasis on Paris: It was in Paris ____ we met.
questions.explanation: En las It-Clefts, se usa 'that' (o 'who' para personas) para unir. 'Where' es menos formal/correcto aquí.

questions.question: Normal: The lack of funds caused the delay. -> ____ caused the delay was the lack of funds.
questions.explanation: Wh-Cleft: What caused the delay was...

questions.question: Normal: I hate his arrogant attitude. -> ____ I hate is his arrogant attitude.
Normal: The board approved the budget on Friday. -> Emphasis on Friday: It was on Friday ____ the board approved the budget.
questions.explanation: It-Cleft con tiempo: It was on Friday THAT...

questions.question: Normal: I am only trying to help you. -> ____ I am trying to do is help you.
questions.explanation: All-Cleft: All I am trying to do is...

questions.question: Normal: Because of the rain, the event was cancelled. -> The reason ____ the event was cancelled was the rain.
Normal: They want to increase our taxes. -> What they want to do ____ increase our taxes.
questions.explanation: What they want to do IS...

questions.question: Normal: I love the company culture here. -> The ____ I love here is the company culture.
questions.explanation: The thing I love is... (Otra forma de Cleft).

questions.question: Normal: Our competitor launched the product first. -> ____ our competitor who launched the product first.
questions.explanation: It-cleft: It was our competitor who...

questions.question: Normal: We need to focus on customer retention. -> ____ we need to focus on is customer retention.
questions.explanation: Wh-cleft: What we need to focus on is...

questions.question: Normal: I only need five minutes of your time. -> ____ I need is five minutes of your time.
Normal: We finally reached an agreement at midnight. -> It was at midnight ____ we finally reached an agreement.
Normal: The software crashed, not the hardware. -> It was the software ____ crashed, not the hardware.
questions.explanation: It-cleft usa THAT (o who para personas).

questions.question: Normal: They didn't listen to the warnings. -> What they didn't do ____ listen to the warnings.
questions.explanation: Pasado: What they didn't do WAS...

questions.question: Normal: I am calling because I need an update. -> The reason ____ I am calling is that I need an update.
Normal: This department generates the most revenue. -> It is this department ____ generates the most revenue.
Normal: You need a vacation. -> What you need ____ a vacation.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra que falta para formar la Cleft Sentence.

questions.question: ____ it was John who did it. (Fue - it-cleft)
It was Mary ____ sent the email. (Quien - formal)
questions.explanation: who (that también es válido, pero who es mejor para personas).

questions.question: ____ we need is a better plan. (Lo que)
What they want ____ more money. (Es)
____ I want is a chance. (Todo lo que / Lo único que)
It was yesterday ____ it happened. (Que - conector it-cleft)
The reason ____ we failed is clear. (Por qué)
What he did ____ quit his job. (Fue)
The ____ I hate is the noise. (Cosa)
It ____ the manager who fired him. (Fue)

pairs.target: Fue John quien (énfasis en la persona)
Fue ayer que (énfasis en el tiempo)
La cosa que me encanta es
Lo que ellos no hicieron fue

pairs.source: All you have to do is
pairs.target: Lo único que tienes que hacer es

It is the CEO who signed it.
It was the CEO that signed it.
He was the CEO who signed it.
